Background
Dr. Upendra Kaul was born on June 14, 1948, in the village of Hawal, Pulwama district, Kashmir. He completed his medical education, including MBBS and MD, and later specialized in cardiology. His journey took him from Kashmir to Delhi, where he became a prominent figure in the medical community, eventually serving as a professor at AIIMS (All India Institute of Medical Sciences).
